scope: Source-bound Python Operation execution through in-memory deferred transaction ports

source_cases.preparation: Reuse complete shared effectful source cases and owned witnesses, retaining source graph, checked action, selected factories, all recipes and all scenarios
source_cases.capacity: Existing witness and case bounds remain whole-node not_evaluable boundaries; no passing prefix

native_boundaries.coroutine: Schedule native call through its first suspension before caller-mutation capture probes; check unresolved begin/read/commit/rollback ports before settlement
native_boundaries.receipt: All malformed Python receipt shapes produce INVALID_COMMIT_RECEIPT; preserve the native API rather than TypeScript exception-derived COMMIT_UNCERTAIN
native_boundaries.cancellation: Replay reachable begin/read/commit/rollback exception cases using native CancelledError with the same explicit failure, cleanup and uncertainty outcomes
native_boundaries.carriers: Shared safe integral JS Number recipes use exact Python integers; unsafe or fractional numbers use floats; explicit BigInt recipes use Python integers; Event decimals retain finite floating outputs
native_boundaries.failures: Check exact source-derived outcome status, stage, code, continuation, cleanup failure, traces, clock calls, read identity and ordered state/outbox batches
native_boundaries.integrity: Require frozen detached output carriers, captured input and clock dependencies, unchanged read data, zero coercion/getter calls and immutable bindings
native_boundaries.observation: Reuse unchanged independent whole-source Operation observer and observe selected Event dependencies even when their individual case budgets are pending; predecessor stages observe transitive Rules and factories
native_boundaries.mutants: Three callable binding controls and two compiling provider substitutions for every selected Operation

execution: One existing bounded isolated Python semantic process and workspace; in-memory fixture providers only
claim_ceiling: No production atomicity, isolation, durability, persistence, event publication, arbitrary Python sandbox or full CLI qualification claim
